name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
description: Measures red blood cells, white blood cells, hemoglobin, and platelets to evaluate overall health.

name: Lipid Profile (Cholesterol)
description: Measures cholesterol and triglyceride levels to assess risk of cardiovascular disease.

name: Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH)
description: Evaluates thyroid gland function and checks for hyperthyroidism or hypothyroidism.

name: HbA1c (Diabetes Tracker)
description: Measures average blood sugar levels over the past 3 months. Essential for diabetes management.

name: Executive Full Body Checkup
description: Comprehensive health screen comprising 60+ parameters including kidney, liver, thyroid, lipids, and CBC.

name: Vitamin D & B12 Combo
description: Checks for key vitamin deficiencies which can cause fatigue, joint pain, and nerve damage.
